corrosion.name: Acid Fang
corrosion.text: An aggressive Chip built around direct integrity damage.

nodes.name: Gorge
nodes.text: Destroying a graft heals 2.

nodes.name: Venom Feed
nodes.text: Destroying a graft gives the opponent 2 Strain.

nodes.name: Corroding Bite
nodes.text: +1 integrity damage dealt (Clash wear included).

nodes.name: Opportunistic Strike
nodes.text: +2 integrity damage dealt (Clash wear included) while the opponent has an active status.

nodes.name: Deep Corrosion
nodes.text: Bleed you inflict lasts 2 rounds longer.

nodes.name: Rusting Strike
nodes.text: +1 integrity damage dealt (Clash wear included) from round 4 on.

nodes.name: Caustic Edge
nodes.text: Your Corrosion cards cost 2 less.

nodes.name: Quick Rust
nodes.text: Your first graft each round costs 1 less.

nodes.name: Clean Claws
nodes.text: +2 attack while you have no active status on yourself.

nodes.name: Tempered Hide
nodes.text: Incoming integrity damage against you is reduced by 1.

nodes.name: Thick Scales
nodes.text: +2 armor.

nodes.name: Reinforced Carapace
nodes.text: Grafts you attach get +2 integrity.

nodes.name: Stalwart Plating
nodes.text: +2 armor while you picked Fortify.

nodes.name: Aegis Ward
nodes.text: Incoming integrity damage against you is reduced by 2 while you're Stable.

nodes.name: Late Reinforcement
nodes.text: Grafts you attach from round 4 on get +3 integrity.

nodes.name: Hardened Plate
nodes.text: +1 armor while you have no active status on yourself.

nodes.name: Slow Mend
nodes.text: At the start of each round, heal 1 integrity on every graft you control.

nodes.name: Vital Surge
nodes.text: Heal 1 extra integrity each round while you have an active status on yourself.

nodes.name: Renewing Pulse
nodes.text: Purging your own statuses also heals 2.

nodes.name: Cleansing Repair
nodes.text: Purging your own statuses also heals 2 integrity across your grafts.

nodes.name: Iron Bulwark
nodes.text: +3 armor while your HP is 20 or less.

nodes.name: Living Bulwark
nodes.text: Hold vents 1 extra Strain.

nodes.name: Steadfast
nodes.text: Replacing a graft costs 1 less.

nodes.name: Enduring Form
nodes.text: Incoming integrity damage against you is reduced by 1 while your HP is 20 or less.

nodes.name: Withering Touch
nodes.text: +1 attack while the opponent has an active status.

nodes.name: Crippling Touch
nodes.text: Fever you inflict lasts 1 round longer.

nodes.name: Spreading Blight
nodes.text: Numb you inflict lasts 1 round longer.

nodes.name: Virulence
nodes.text: Fever you inflict lasts 1 round longer while you're Overclocked.

nodes.name: Iron Grip
nodes.text: Numb you inflict lasts 1 round longer while you picked Adapt.

nodes.name: Loosening Grip
nodes.text: Disable you inflict lasts 1 round longer.

nodes.name: Clarity
nodes.text: +1 attack while you picked Adapt.

nodes.name: Discipline
nodes.text: Cycling to vent, vents 1 extra Strain.

nodes.name: Festering
nodes.text: Fever you inflict lasts 1 round longer while you have an active status on yourself.

nodes.name: Contagious
nodes.text: Numb you inflict lasts 1 round longer while the opponent already has an active status.

nodes.name: Relapsing Fever
nodes.text: Destroying a graft heals 2 integrity across your grafts while you have an active status on yourself.

nodes.name: Recurring Numb
nodes.text: +1 armor per graft you control while you have an active status on yourself.

nodes.name: Deep Grave
nodes.text: Necrosis you inflict lasts 1 round longer.

nodes.name: Shallow Grave
nodes.text: Necrosis you inflict lasts 1 round longer from round 4 on.

nodes.name: Death Toll
nodes.text: Necrosing a graft also vents 1 Strain for you.

nodes.name: Harvest Soul
nodes.text: Destroying a graft draws 1 card.

nodes.name: Sacred Rite
nodes.text: Purging your own statuses heals 2 while the opponent has an active status.

nodes.name: Solemn Rite
nodes.text: Purging your own statuses vents 2 Strain while the opponent has an active status.

nodes.name: Clear Mind
nodes.text: +1 armor while the opponent has an active status.

nodes.name: Clear Body
nodes.text: +1 attack while the opponent has 6+ Strain.

nodes.name: Null Field
nodes.text: +2 armor while your Strain is 3 or less.

nodes.name: Void Field
nodes.text: Incoming integrity damage against you is reduced by 1 while your Strain is 3 or less.

nodes.name: Stillness
nodes.text: Numb you inflict lasts 1 round longer while your Strain is 6+.

nodes.name: Silence
nodes.text: Destroying a graft heals 3 while the opponent has an active status.
